name: ndot design tokens
source: prototypes/ndot-site/site.css in Nianthony/n-interactive-prototype, extended with the publisher-deck collage tones
note: Contrast ratios are computed (WCAG 2.1), not eyeballed. CSS twin: tokens.css

accentBand.use: the accent, lifted for the band

rules: The brand is black and white. The accent is editorial chrome, under 2% of surface. Remove the two accent tokens and the system still works, achromatic.
#A6231A on #131310 is 2.55:1 and is a banned pair. Inside a band the accent must be #E86A52.
Never a low-alpha white hairline on the band. The transparent version measured 1.37:1. Use solid #6A6A63.
Hard corners everywhere. The only round things are dots, because a dot is the mark.
No gradients and no shadows on page content.
No map, no geography, no pins, no coordinates. A dot field reads as the sister company's county map.
Every element is TYPE, a RULE, a piece of DATA, or a numbered record.

mono.role: system layer only: labels, folios, ordinals, data captions, table heads, page numbers

grid.note: Construction guides sit on the 96px lattice, never between it, and never closer than two columns to each other. They stay off the outer boundaries and out of the folio and foot bands.

motif.unitDot: One dot, one unit, wherever a quantity is shown: one percentage point, one revenue multiple, one reader in a hundred. State the unit in a caption.
motif.isoBox: An isometric box with the accent dot held at its inner corner. The accent appears exactly once per composition, as that dot.
motif.grain: A seeded 90px grit tile at 0.20 over paper, 0.16 over the band. assets/textures/ has it flat and tiled, opaque and transparent.
